response.sql:
WITH eligible_winners AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS hand
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM eligible_winners
    GROUP BY hand
)
SELECT hand, winner_count,
       1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts
ORDER BY hand;

assumptions.assumption: Count each manager_award record as one winner; repeated records for a player (for different awards or years) count separately.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct players within each batting-hand group, so a player with multiple manager award records counts once.

    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM eligible_winners
    GROUP BY hand
)
SELECT hand, winner_count,
       1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts
ORDER BY hand;
